body: INFRA-DATA-01 documentation and static contract now agree with the frozen file-sync design: prepare.sh installs orders_file_sync.csv at /datara/files/fixtures/orders_file_sync.csv; product synchronization uses endpoint_select baseMode=file_sync with filePath and fileType=csv; the resources upload domain remains restricted to SQL/Python/Shell artifacts. The API seeder exchanges the server-side development key for a short-lived token, enforces host 192.168.1.9 for live execution, and dry-run performs no key read or network access. Verification: API seeder contract 7 passed, fixture contract 5 passed, dry-run passed.
